snippet.title: A Silly Noisy House (Playthrough)
snippet.description:
Here is a full playthrough of A Silly Noisy House by Peggy Weil. I figured I would create this and upload it since I couldn't find a playthrough of this on YouTube.

To play it, I ran Mac OS 8.6 in SheepShaver and installed a copy of the game I found online. It mostly ran fine, except for one error popup I received and some animation speed issues (computers are way faster now, ha!). Anyway, enjoy!

Here is a page with some more info about the game:
https://pweilstudio.com/project/silly-noisy-house/
